1 | # Documentation - AI Assistant Instructions
2 | 
3 | This file provides guidelines for building and maintaining SQLFluff documentation.
4 | 
5 | ## Documentation System
6 | 
7 | SQLFluff uses **Sphinx** for documentation generation with:
8 | - **Source**: `docs/source/` (reStructuredText files)
9 | - **Build output**: `docs/build/` (HTML, generated)
10 | - **Live docs**: https://docs.sqlfluff.com
11 | - **Auto-generated content**: API docs, rule reference, dialect lists
12 | 
13 | ## Documentation Structure
14 | 
15 | ```
16 | docs/
17 | ├── source/                        # Documentation source files
18 | │   ├── conf.py                    # Sphinx configuration
19 | │   ├── index.rst                  # Homepage
20 | │   ├── gettingstarted.rst         # Getting started guide
21 | │   ├── why_sqlfluff.rst          # Project overview
22 | │   ├── inthewild.rst             # Real-world usage
23 | │   ├── jointhecommunity.rst      # Community info
24 | │   ├── configuration/            # Configuration docs
25 | │   │   ├── index.rst
26 | │   │   └── setting_configuration.rst
27 | │   ├── guides/                   # Developer guides
28 | │   │   ├── index.rst
29 | │   │   ├── first_contribution.rst
30 | │   │   └── dialect_development.rst
31 | │   ├── reference/                # API and rule reference
32 | │   │   ├── index.rst
33 | │   │   ├── rules.rst
34 | │   │   └── api.rst
35 | │   ├── production/               # Production deployment
36 | │   ├── _static/                  # Static assets (CSS, images)
37 | │   ├── _ext/                     # Sphinx extensions
38 | │   └── _partials/                # Reusable doc fragments
39 | ├── build/                        # Generated HTML (gitignored)
40 | ├── Makefile                      # Build commands (Unix)
41 | ├── make.bat                      # Build commands (Windows)
42 | ├── requirements.txt              # Doc build dependencies
43 | └── README.md                     # Documentation README
44 | 
45 | ../generate-auto-docs.py          # Script to generate auto-docs
46 | ```
47 | 
48 | ## Building Documentation Locally
49 | 
50 | ### Setup
51 | 
52 | ```bash
53 | # Activate virtual environment
54 | source .venv/bin/activate
55 | 
56 | # Install documentation dependencies
57 | pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
58 | ```
59 | 
60 | ### Building HTML Docs
61 | 
62 | ```bash
63 | # Navigate to docs directory
64 | cd docs
65 | 
66 | # Build HTML (Unix/Linux/Mac)
67 | make html
68 | 
69 | # Build HTML (Windows)
70 | make.bat html
71 | 
72 | # View built documentation
73 | open build/html/index.html  # macOS
74 | xdg-open build/html/index.html  # Linux
75 | # Or manually open docs/build/html/index.html in browser
76 | ```
77 | 
78 | ### Clean Build
79 | 
80 | ```bash
81 | cd docs
82 | 
83 | # Clean previous build
84 | make clean
85 | 
86 | # Build fresh
87 | make html
88 | ```
89 | 
90 | ### Live Reload During Development
91 | 
92 | For rapid iteration, use `sphinx-autobuild`:
93 | 
94 | ```bash
95 | # Install sphinx-autobuild
96 | pip install sphinx-autobuild
97 | 
98 | # Run live-reload server
99 | cd docs
100 | sphinx-autobuild source build/html
101 | 
102 | # Open browser to http://127.0.0.1:8000
103 | # Docs rebuild automatically on file changes
104 | ```
105 | 
106 | ## Documentation Format
107 | 
108 | ### reStructuredText (RST)
109 | 
110 | SQLFluff docs use RST format (`.rst` files).
111 | 
112 | **Basic syntax:**
113 | 
114 | ```rst
115 | Page Title
116 | ==========
117 | 
118 | Section Heading
119 | ---------------
120 | 
121 | Subsection
122 | ~~~~~~~~~~
123 | 
124 | **Bold text**
125 | 
126 | *Italic text*
127 | 
128 | ``inline code``
129 | 
130 | `Link text <https://example.com>`_
131 | 
132 | - Bullet list item
133 | - Another item
134 | 
135 | 1. Numbered list
136 | 2. Second item
137 | 
138 | .. code-block:: sql
139 | 
140 |    SELECT * FROM users
141 |    WHERE active = 1;
142 | 
143 | .. code-block:: python
144 | 
145 |    from sqlfluff.core import Linter
146 |    linter = Linter(dialect="tsql")
147 | 
148 | .. note::
149 |    This is a note box.
150 | 
151 | .. warning::
152 |    This is a warning box.
153 | ```
154 | 
155 | ### Cross-References
156 | 
157 | ```rst
158 | Link to another doc:
159 | :doc:`gettingstarted`
160 | 
161 | Link to section:
162 | :ref:`configuration-label`
163 | 
164 | Link to Python class:
165 | :class:`sqlfluff.core.Linter`
166 | 
167 | Link to function:
168 | :func:`sqlfluff.lint`
169 | ```
170 | 
171 | ## Documentation Types
172 | 
173 | ### User-Facing Documentation
174 | 
175 | **Getting Started** (`gettingstarted.rst`):
176 | - Installation instructions
177 | - Quick start examples
178 | - Basic usage patterns
179 | 
180 | **Configuration** (`configuration/`):
181 | - Configuration file format
182 | - Available settings
183 | - Dialect-specific config
184 | 
185 | **Rules Reference** (`reference/rules.rst`):
186 | - Auto-generated from rule metadata
187 | - Rule descriptions, examples, configuration options
188 | - **Updated automatically** via `generate-auto-docs.py`
189 | 
190 | ### Developer Documentation
191 | 
192 | **Guides** (`guides/`):
193 | - First contribution walkthrough
194 | - Dialect development guide
195 | - Rule development guide
196 | - Architecture overview
197 | 
198 | **API Reference** (`reference/api.rst`):
199 | - Auto-generated from docstrings
200 | - Python API documentation
201 | - Class and function references
202 | 
203 | ### Production Documentation
204 | 
205 | **Production** (`production/`):
206 | - CI/CD integration
207 | - Performance tuning
208 | - Deployment best practices
209 | 
210 | ## Auto-Generated Documentation
211 | 
212 | ### Generating Auto-Docs
213 | 
214 | Some documentation is generated from source code:
215 | 
216 | ```bash
217 | # Generate auto-documentation (rules, dialects, etc.)
218 | python docs/generate-auto-docs.py
219 | 
220 | # Build docs after generation
221 | cd docs
222 | make html
223 | ```
224 | 
225 | **What gets auto-generated:**
226 | - Rule reference (from rule metadata)
227 | - Dialect list (from available dialects)
228 | - API documentation (from docstrings)
229 | 
230 | ### Rule Documentation
231 | 
232 | Rules are documented via their metadata:
233 | 
234 | ```python
235 | class Rule_AL01(BaseRule):
236 |     """Implicit aliasing of table not allowed.
237 | 
238 |     **Anti-pattern**
239 | 
240 |     Using implicit alias for tables:
241 | 
242 |     .. code-block:: sql
243 | 
244 |         SELECT * FROM users u
245 | 
246 |     **Best practice**
247 | 
248 |     Use explicit AS keyword:
249 | 
250 |     .. code-block:: sql
251 | 
252 |         SELECT * FROM users AS u
253 |     """
254 | 
255 |     groups = ("all", "aliasing")
256 |     # ... rest of rule
257 | ```
258 | 
259 | Docstring is extracted and added to rule reference docs.
260 | 
261 | ## Documentation Style Guide
262 | 
263 | ### Writing Style
264 | 
265 | - **Clear and concise**: Use simple language
266 | - **Active voice**: "Run the command" not "The command should be run"
267 | - **Present tense**: "SQLFluff parses SQL" not "SQLFluff will parse SQL"
268 | - **Examples**: Include code examples for every feature
269 | - **User perspective**: Write from user's point of view
270 | 
271 | ### Code Examples
272 | 
273 | **Always include:**
274 | - Context (what the example demonstrates)
275 | - Complete, runnable code
276 | - Expected output when relevant
277 | 
278 | **SQL examples:**
279 | ```rst
280 | .. code-block:: sql
281 | 
282 |    -- Anti-pattern: implicit alias
283 |    SELECT * FROM users u;
284 | 
285 | .. code-block:: sql
286 | 
287 |    -- Best practice: explicit alias
288 |    SELECT * FROM users AS u;
289 | ```
290 | 
291 | **Python examples:**
292 | ```rst
293 | .. code-block:: python
294 | 
295 |    from sqlfluff.core import Linter
296 | 
297 |    linter = Linter(dialect="tsql")
298 |    result = linter.lint_string("SELECT * FROM users")
299 |    print(result.violations)
300 | ```
301 | 
302 | **Shell examples:**
303 | ```rst
304 | .. code-block:: bash
305 | 
306 |    # Lint a SQL file
307 |    sqlfluff lint query.sql
308 | 
309 |    # Fix issues automatically
310 |    sqlfluff fix query.sql
311 | ```
312 | 
313 | ### Sections and Headers
314 | 
315 | Use consistent header hierarchy:
316 | 
317 | ```rst
318 | Page Title (Top Level)
319 | ======================
320 | 
321 | Major Section
322 | -------------
323 | 
324 | Subsection
325 | ~~~~~~~~~~
326 | 
327 | Sub-subsection
328 | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
329 | ```
330 | 
331 | ### Links and References
332 | 
333 | **External links:**
334 | ```rst
335 | See the `official documentation <https://docs.sqlfluff.com>`_ for details.
336 | ```
337 | 
338 | **Internal cross-references:**
339 | ```rst
340 | For configuration options, see :doc:`configuration/index`.
341 | 
342 | As described in :ref:`dialect-development`, each dialect...
343 | ```
344 | 
345 | **Define reference labels:**
346 | ```rst
347 | .. _dialect-development:
348 | 
349 | Dialect Development
350 | -------------------
351 | 
352 | This section covers dialect development...
353 | ```

355 | ## Checking Documentation Quality
356 | 
357 | ### Sphinx Warnings
358 | 
359 | Sphinx warns about issues during build:
360 | 
361 | ```bash
362 | cd docs
363 | make html
364 | 
365 | # Look for warnings like:
366 | # WARNING: document isn't included in any toctree
367 | # WARNING: undefined label: some-label
368 | # ERROR: Unknown directive type "cod-block"  (typo!)
369 | ```
370 | 
371 | Fix all warnings before committing documentation changes.
372 | 
373 | ### Link Checking
374 | 
375 | ```bash
376 | cd docs
377 | 
378 | # Check for broken links
379 | make linkcheck
380 | 
381 | # Review output for HTTP errors, redirects, broken anchors
382 | ```
383 | 
384 | ### Spell Checking
385 | 
386 | SQLFluff uses `codespell` for spell checking:
387 | 
388 | ```bash
389 | # Run from repository root
390 | codespell docs/source/
391 | 
392 | # Or via pre-commit
393 | .venv/bin/pre-commit run codespell --all-files
394 | ```
395 | 
396 | ## Documentation Workflow
397 | 
398 | ### Adding New Documentation
399 | 
400 | 1. **Create or edit `.rst` file** in `docs/source/`
401 | 2. **Add to table of contents** (toctree) in parent `index.rst`:
402 |    ```rst
403 |    .. toctree::
404 |       :maxdepth: 2
405 | 
406 |       existing_page
407 |       new_page
408 |    ```
409 | 3. **Build and review:**
410 |    ```bash
411 |    cd docs
412 |    make clean html
413 |    open build/html/index.html
414 |    ```
415 | 4. **Check for warnings** during build
416 | 5. **Run link checker:**
417 |    ```bash
418 |    make linkcheck
419 |    ```
420 | 6. **Commit both source and auto-generated files** if applicable
421 | 
422 | ### Updating Existing Documentation
423 | 
424 | 1. **Edit `.rst` file**
425 | 2. **Rebuild docs:**
426 |    ```bash
427 |    cd docs
428 |    make html
429 |    ```
430 | 3. **Review changes** in browser
431 | 4. **Check for new warnings**
432 | 5. **Commit changes**
433 | 
434 | ### Adding Code Examples
435 | 
436 | 1. **Create example in `examples/`** directory (optional):
437 |    ```python
438 |    # examples/08_new_feature.py
439 |    from sqlfluff.core import Linter
440 | 
441 |    linter = Linter(dialect="tsql")
442 |    result = linter.lint_string("SELECT * FROM users")
443 |    print(result.violations)
444 |    ```
445 | 
446 | 2. **Reference in documentation:**
447 |    ```rst
448 |    .. literalinclude:: ../../examples/08_new_feature.py
449 |       :language: python
450 |       :linenos:
451 |    ```
452 | 
453 | 3. **Or embed directly:**
454 |    ```rst
455 |    .. code-block:: python
456 | 
457 |       from sqlfluff.core import Linter
458 |       linter = Linter(dialect="tsql")
459 |    ```
460 | 
461 | ## Common Documentation Tasks
462 | 
463 | ### Document New Rule
464 | 
465 | 1. **Add docstring to rule class** with anti-pattern and best practice
466 | 2. **Regenerate docs:**
467 |    ```bash
468 |    python docs/generate-auto-docs.py
469 |    ```
470 | 3. **Build and verify:**
471 |    ```bash
472 |    cd docs && make html
473 |    ```
474 | 
475 | ### Document New Dialect
476 | 
477 | 1. **Add dialect overview** to `reference/dialects.rst` or create new file
478 | 2. **Include supported features** and known limitations
479 | 3. **Provide examples** of dialect-specific syntax
480 | 4. **Update auto-generated dialect list:**
481 |    ```bash
482 |    python docs/generate-auto-docs.py
483 |    ```
484 | 
485 | ### Add Tutorial/Guide
486 | 
487 | 1. **Create new `.rst` file** in `docs/source/guides/`
488 | 2. **Add to toctree** in `docs/source/guides/index.rst`
489 | 3. **Include step-by-step instructions** with examples
490 | 4. **Build and test** all commands/code in tutorial
491 | 
492 | ## Sphinx Configuration
493 | 
494 | Configuration in `docs/source/conf.py`:
495 | 
496 | **Key settings:**
497 | - `project`: "SQLFluff"
498 | - `extensions`: Sphinx extensions used
499 | - `html_theme`: Documentation theme
500 | - `html_static_path`: Static assets directory
501 | 
502 | **Custom extensions** in `docs/source/_ext/`:
503 | - Custom directives or roles
504 | - Auto-documentation generators
505 | 
506 | ## Testing Documentation Build in CI
507 | 
508 | Documentation builds are tested in CI/CD:
509 | - Ensures no Sphinx warnings or errors
510 | - Validates all links
511 | - Checks for spelling errors
512 | 
513 | **Local pre-check before committing:**
514 | ```bash
515 | # Build docs
516 | cd docs && make clean html
517 | 
518 | # Check links
519 | make linkcheck
520 | 
521 | # Spell check
522 | cd .. && codespell docs/source/
523 | 
524 | # Review any warnings/errors
525 | ```

1 | # SQLFluff - Generating the document website
2 | 
3 | You can run the following steps to generate the documentation website:
4 | 
5 | ```
6 | tox -e docbuild,doclinting
7 | ```
8 | 
9 | The `docbuild` job will recognise when source files have changed and only
10 | generate the changed files. To force a clean build (for example when changing
11 | config) rather than the source files use the following command from the project
12 | root directory (drop the `-C docs` if running from within the `docs` directory).
13 | 
14 | ```
15 | make -C docs clean
16 | ```
17 | 
18 | The built HTML should be placed in `docs/build/html` and can be opened directly
19 | in the browser or you can launch a simple webserver with the below command
20 | and then navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8000/ to view the site locally:
21 | 
22 | ```
23 | python -m http.server --directory docs/build/html
24 | ```
25 | 
26 | Again, this command is run from the root server, not the `docs` subfolder but you
27 | can alter the path as appropriate if needs be.
28 | 
29 | If you don't want to use `tox`, then you can complete the steps manually with
30 | the following commands after setting up your Python environment as detailed
31 | in the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) file.
32 | 
33 | ```
34 | cd docs
35 | pip install -r requirements.txt
36 | make html
37 | python -m http.server --directory build/html
38 | ```
39 | 
40 | Or alternatively from the root folder:
41 | 
42 | ```
43 | pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
44 | make -C docs html
45 | python -m http.server --directory docs/build/html
46 | ```
47 | 
48 | The docs use Sphinx and are generated from the source code.
49 | The config is available in `docs/source/conf.py`.
